svg.text: detection-lab · validated against live attack telemetry
Every rule ran against real kernel telemetry from attacks in a throwaway Linux lab, and against 150 windows of ordinary activity.
Each carries a measured true-positive count and a false-positive rate, not a guess.
Tactic columns, technique cells, coloured by what the harness measured. Dashed = the rule names a field this lab does not carry.
One clean shipper, one too noisy to keep, one proven broken. The broken row is the point.
